text:
Renee: Quick poll idea  'Sunset sandwich stroll' Friday? grab sandwiches from the corner deli and walk to the pier for sunset. 5:45 lobby meet? :sandwich: :sunset:
Sam: love that. can we do vegetarian options?
Jon: i'm in. i can bring a portable blanket for the pier.
Priya: RSVP yes. can someone check if the pier allows small groups after 6?
Maya: i'll DM facilities, quick check. also can we cap at 10 so it's not too crowded?
Renee: cap 10 works. PollBot can you run an RSVP + transport poll (walk / bike / carpool)?
PollBot: Poll created: "Sunset sandwich stroll RSVP" Options: Yes (walk), Yes (bike), Yes (carpool), Maybe, No. Link: https://polls.example/2074
Sam: i'll bring veggie sandwiches (and GF bread on request).
Jon: i have 3 seats if anyone needs a ride from Northgate.
Priya: i'll take one seat if still available. thanks Jon.
Maya: facilities replied: pier is fine for small groups but no amplified music. noted.
Renee: perfect. budget ~$12 each? i'll create calendar invite and include poll link. link: https://calendar.example/event/2074567890-sunset-stroll
Sam: RSVP yes (walk). bringing napkins and wet wipes.
Jon: RSVP yes (carpool). leaving at 5:30. DM me pickup spot.
Renee: sweet. see you Friday  bring layers and a sandwich appetite. :sparkles:
